sonnet.problem: The True statement (the fleece is wet with dew and the ground is dry, just as Gideon asked) repeats the correct answer of the card right before it (card 6: dew only on the fleece and dry ground). It re-asks the same fleece-and-dew fact, so the baker can mark True without reasoning.
sonnet.rule: A True statement never just repeats the card before it.
